STREAM_API_KEY.description: The exception among realtime providers: Stream's own client snippet passes the raw key to the browser when initialising the chat client, so a working install publishes it. One pair serves every Stream product in an application.

STREAM_API_SECRET.description: Stream says user tokens can only be safely generated from a server. Compromised tokens are revoked by a cutoff time rather than by rotating this, and that cutoff can be lifted again.
